metadata.title: Nvidia reportedly approaches Arm CEO Rene Haas for top job after Jensen Huang exit

content.text:
Investing.com. -- Arm Holdings Chief Executive Officer Rene Haas has been reportedly approached about potentially taking the top job at Nvidia, as the chipmaker begins searching for a successor following Jensen Huang's departure last week.
Recruiting firm Heidrick & Struggles, which was hired by Nvidia's board to oversee the leadership search, has contacted Haas about the position, , Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday citing a person familiar with the matter. The firm has also begun approaching other executives who could be considered for the role.
The search comes at a critical juncture for Nvidia, which has become one of the world's most valuable companies as demand for its artificial intelligence processors surges. The company sits at the centre of the global AI investment boom, supplying the advanced chips that power data centres and large-scale AI models.
Haas's potential candidacy would bring an experienced semiconductor executive into consideration. He has led Arm since 2022, overseeing its expansion as demand for its chip designs grows across data centres, smartphones and AI-related applications.
The outreach does not indicate that Haas has agreed to pursue the position or that Nvidia has made a decision on its next chief executive. The recruitment process remains ongoing.
